parse_tar_in_memory: parse an in-memory TAR file from bytes and yield file paths with memoryview contents
parse_tar_file_object: parse a TAR file from a file-like object and yield file paths with byte contents
iterate_tar_entries: iterate over all entries in a TAR archive yielding tuples of file name and data
benchmark_tar_parsing: benchmark TAR file parsing performance comparing iter_tarfile with Python built-in tarfile module
preview_tar_contents: preview the first 30 bytes of each file inside a TAR archive using iter_tarfile
